status: All alternatives must retain fixed invariants; no selection

recommendations.candidate: Registered manifest resolver with explicit move/clone association
recommendations.admissible_competitor: Path or remote alias resolver backed by the same canonical stable IDs and explicit association
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Admitted move splits identity, equal bytes merge distinct registrations, or copied manifest self-authorizes
recommendations.passing_test_nonproof: Stability does not prove source fidelity or access rights
recommendations.negative_control: Pure path/URL/commit identity

recommendations.candidate: Typed manifest content address with explicit logical/raw/coherence facets

recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Two distinct promised states share admitted identity, or a missing component receives complete status
recommendations.passing_test_nonproof: Digest does not prove coherent capture or durable availability
recommendations.negative_control: Commit hash alone for dirty work
